title: Halloween Fruit Tray
summary: I make basic fruits instantly more festive with a Halloween fruit tray. I arrange clementines, strawberries, grapes, blueberries, and green apple slices into a jack-o'-lantern face that is the perfect…
ingredients: 1 cup red grapes (washed and picked off the vine)
steps: Peel clementines and separate them into wedges. Cover tray completely with wedges.
Slice strawberries in half. Arrange into a smile.
Place washed blueberries into the center. Arrange into a circle or triangle for the nose.
Wash grapes. Arrange into two equal circles to make the eyes.
Slice green apple into wedges. Arrange at the top to create the pumpkin stem.
